scope: Local managed API/worker supervision preparation. Real stand-in processes exercise paired exit and signal behavior; application API, database connections, Cognito and hosted runtime are not executed by these controls.
controls: Separate API/worker credential environments; no inherited model, AWS, demo or proxy settings
Private bounded settings, no symlink; distinct PostgreSQL logins on same database with verify-full
Unexpected zero/nonzero child exit stops sibling and returns failure
SIGTERM and SIGINT stop both services
Second-child spawn failure cleans up first child and restores signal handler
limitations: Process-group signaling is not containment of descendants that create their own session. Actual worker analysis uses a separate session; whole-container cleanup must be verified before hosted use.
No hung-process detection, external watchdog, shared sessions or automatic restart.
Role strings and TLS options are preflight checks, not live database privilege or certificate acceptance.
Default CLI binds loopback with proxy headers disabled; not a public hosting entry point.
Initial Linux collection used an old image without managed-sign-in source and failed. Repeated with explicit current read-only source; that run passed.
